name: Lechfall
kurzbeschreibung: The Lechfall Waterfall at the threshold of the Lech Gorge near Füssen and Reutte features a twelve-metre cascade where the wild River Lech plunges into a narrow canyon.
preis: Freely accessible; curbside parking bays along Tiroler Straße apply small parking fees
beschreibung:
Überblick

The historically rich Lechfall Waterfall sits at the southern outskirts of Füssen directly along the Austrian-Bavarian frontier, marking the dramatic transition of the untamed Tyrolean River Lech into the Alpine foothills. At this protected geological monument, the milky turquoise torrents of the Northern Alps' last great braided wild river plunge over a stepped twelve-metre weir directly into the narrow, vertical abyss of the Lech Gorge. Carved roughly 12,000 years ago during the melting of the Würm glacier, the canyon saw glacial floodwaters saw relentless chasms into hard limestone bedrocks. Spanning directly across the churning cascade is the historic 'Maxsteg' footbridge, constructed in 1895 to provide walkers with an exhilarating vertical perspective into frothing eddies and the shadowy limestone gorge gateway. A cliff-cut bust commemorating Bavarian King Maximilian II and the legendary 'Magnustritt' hollow endow this roaring spectacle with storied cultural heritage.

Route & Anforderungen

Viewing the Lechfall is effortless, making it an ideal brief outing or a scenic prelude to longer hikes. Paved paths lead from nearby roadside parking bays to the Maxsteg bridge and viewing belvederes in less than five minutes. Visitors wishing to stretch their legs can ascend the Kalvarienberg hill loop or follow the famed Lechweg long-distance trail upstream toward Reutte and the Tiroler Lech Nature Park. The viewing decks and footbridge are secured with sturdy railings year-round and require no alpine experience; standard walking sneakers suffice. Paved walkways on the northern approach are stroller-friendly.

Besuch & Anreise

Motorists arrive via highway B179 from Reutte or highway B17 from Germany, following Tiroler Straße to the roadside parking areas. By rail, travelers arrive at Füssen or Reutte railway stations, connecting via regional buses or walking roughly twenty minutes from Füssen's historic center.

Tipps

Visit the Lechfall during early summer snowmelt when swollen alpine torrents unleash thunderous hydraulic power over the stepped falls. Combine your stop with a short ascent of the Kalvarienberg hill for distant vistas across royal castles Neuschwanstein and Hohenschwangau.
